notes.title: Audio update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576765/f2c54c8cb1e88d1317230084cb77d972b3ce73bd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve just updated the demo to include full sound effects and audio. This means you can finally experience the demo with all the atmosphere, cues, and feedback we intended.[/p][p]We’d love to hear what you think—especially how the sound changes the feel of the game![/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback so far.[/p][p]— B[/p]
